source_form: 10-slide official NASA presentation, not a tabular research journal paper. Body differs in detail from citation abstract; original slide expressions are authoritative.
adjudicator: Developer original-source review before any model preparation/output; not independent expert scientific gold.
basis: Prospective31-target sample over all substantive slides, including historical, proposed, normative, measured-result, current-development, future-work and qualified-author roles. Not exhaustive publication recall. Captions accessible as text; image-only damage not inferred.
